scope: P1 particle-guided optical attempt order with geometric fallback; fixed ring21 prior proof retained

commands.description: experiment.Explore=Particle; seed3 default random/extreme, negative_info=False random, particle_tries=3 random
Independent trace timing and clears; latent screening ground-truth audit isolated from strategy; forced heuristic failure/empty-particle fallback tests

semantic_review.public_inputs: Particles derived solely from tracked public-bearing polygon; histories from own trace contain public measure/clear responses, coordinates and channel. No simulator-source access in online class.
semantic_review.negative_info: Minimum feasible radius max(1000,positive distances); only negative points strictly inside that radius constrain half-plane orientation. Angular boundaries/midpoints enumerate sign cells. Boundary relaxation affects heuristic plausibility only.
semantic_review.guarantee: Filtering negative observations and failed-clear disks changes particle weights/order only; polygon and finite scan nodes unchanged. After bounded optical attempts or empty particle list, inherited complete rectangle sweep runs.
semantic_review.sampling: Triangle selection weighted by triangle area, low-discrepancy barycentric samples stay inside each triangle; heuristic sampling is not a probability or completeness proof.

P2: No improvement or 350 s/source claim follows from these minimal cases.
negative_info screening permits angular boundary false positives intentionally; this weakens ranking only and is not a proof of posterior feasibility.

rework: None for P1. Full evaluation and P2 required before delivery; substantive changes invalidate affected gate.
